text:
tara: Quick sync — we need to lock the Console observability launch slice for dashboards + tracing hooks. Customers (AcmeHealth, LogiAI) are pushing for cost breakdown + error analytics in the first pass. Can we agree minimum scope and gating?

mike: I can own trace hooks + basic tokenized cost breakdown. Biggest risk: sampling strategy and hot-path latency when we enable prefix/KV cache tracing.

juan: For SRE, must-have: sampling defaults that keep p50 p95 latency under current SLOs. Also we need rollout flags per-org and an emergency off switch.

sarah: Design note — dashboard widgets should be composable. For launch, propose 3 tiles: cost-by-model, error-rate-trend, top-traced-flows. Mockups ready, but need final API fields.

oliver: PMM/customer asks — customers want: 1) cost attribution to route/model, 2) trace links to example requests, 3) error grouping by stack/handler. Any of these we can defer?

mike: Deferable: full request-level replay and deep error grouping. Must: route/model cost, aggregated error buckets, and trace ids in logs. Can do replay as follow-up.

tara: OK consensus forming. Proposed launch must-haves (tiny acceptance doc):

```
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Dashboard: 3 tiles (cost-by-model, error-rate-trend, top-traced-flows) with export CSV
- Tracing hooks: span-id+trace-id emitted for generation requests, sampled at default 1% per-org
- Cost breakdown: per-route and per-model token cost, 24h and 7d views
- Error analytics: grouped by message/error signature, links to 10 example traces
- Rollout: feature-flag per-org, canary at 5% then 25% then 100%
- Safeguards: global emergency off; default sampling keeps p95 below current SLO
```

mike: Implementation note — sampling default 1% keeps overhead minimal. We'll add a dynamic sampler later. I'll PR schema for tiles by EOD.

juan: Need a small smoke test matrix for oncall. I can write it if someone outlines the traces we expect.

sarah: I'll attach simplified mocks + component props in Figma link: https://redwood.app/figma/obs-launch (placeholder).

oliver: Planning ask — can we commit to 2-week visibility after canary to gather customer signals for Optimize recommendations?

tara: Yes, 2-week observation window. If telemetry shows >0.5% regressions in latency or >2x error surface, we pause rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy started: obs/trace-hooks v1 -> canary (5%) by mike. See: https://deploys.redwood/obs/1768004322

mike: Thanks — will post PR and quick README for feature flags. Leaving follow-ups: sampling tuning, example-trace access control, and CSV export pagination.

tara: Great work team. Next sync Thurs 10am to confirm canary metrics and finalize launch notes.
